findings.title: Require admin authorization for the bulk export
findings.comment: `@authenticated` admits every valid session, so a member such as `tok-ana` can request `/exports/all` and receive documents from Globex as well as Acme, violating the documented cross-tenant admin boundary. Decorate this handler with `@admin_only` so non-admin sessions receive 403 instead of all tenants' contents.

findings.title: Return the persisted revision from save_document
findings.comment: This now returns the row count even though `handle_put_document` still exposes the result as `revision` and uses it in the ETag. For example, creating a two-row document persists revision 1 but responds with revision 2; a client that sends that value as its next `expected_revision` gets a spurious 409. Return `current + 1` here, or otherwise make the handler read and return the persisted revision.

findings.title: Stop each page at the exclusive limit
findings.comment: Because `last` is already `first + limit`, slicing through `last + 1` returns `limit + 1` entries and overlaps adjacent pages. With `limit=1` and documents `a`, `b`, and `c`, pages 1 and 2 become `[a, b]` and `[b, c]`; slice through `last` instead.

explanation: incorrect — The full three-file diff was inspected, and the affected request paths were exercised against a temporary store. The change exposes cross-tenant data to non-admins, reports incorrect revisions after writes, and produces oversized, overlapping pages.
